Apparent age in the late teens with a mature, intense demeanor. Slim, athletic build. A dark, futuristic naval uniform in shades of charcoal and midnight blue with metallic silver trim. Signature features include a mechanical headset and a massive, dark-colored aircraft-themed rigging.
